// @autogenerated
Uid* (string)::
Unique identifier of the theme.
Tenant (xref:#entidad-tenant[Tenant])::
Tenant that overrides the theme. Empty for the global theme, used as fallback.
Name* (string)::
Name templates use to select the theme (template.theme), e.g. full-window or index-page.
Is default (boolean)::
Theme used by templates that do not name one.
Enabled (boolean)::
Disabled themes are not used when rendering.
Version (integer)::
Campo con el número de version de theme para controlar bloqueos optimistas
